entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier used in ESM messages to reference EPS bearer contexts. Invalid values include assigned/reserved values in certain contexts or values that don't match existing bearers.

entities.name: ESM cause #43
entities.description: ESM cause value indicating 'invalid EPS bearer identity'. Used in reject and status messages when invalid EPS bearer identity is detected.

entities.name: Network handling of invalid EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Network procedures for handling unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen EPS bearer identity values in ESM message headers.

entities.name: UE handling of invalid EPS bearer identity
entities.description: UE procedures for handling unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen EPS bearer identity values in ESM message headers.

entities.name: Invalid EPS bearer identity condition
entities.description: Condition where received EPS bearer identity is assigned/reserved in wrong context or doesn't match existing bearer context.

relations.description: Network handling procedure is triggered by detection of invalid EPS bearer identity condition
UE handling procedure is triggered by detection of invalid EPS bearer identity condition
Detection of invalid EPS bearer identity condition leads to generation of ESM cause #43
